title: Isocenter
description: A Python library for indexing, de-identifying, and exporting DICOM datasets at cohort scale. Builds a SQLite metadata index and a binary pixel/waveform sidecar over a read-only source tree, applies DICOM PS3.15 de-identification profiles and machine-specific pixel redaction in memory, and writes clean copies to a new directory. Exports DICOM or PhysioNet WFDB, including a waveform annotation bridge to Murmur Studio. Source data is never modified.
